blurb: A small duchy that became the capital of German literature.

facts.t: Goethe lived in Weimar for more than 50 years and finished Faust in his house on the Frauenplan, where he died in 1832.

facts.h: Bach and Liszt worked here too
facts.t: Bach was court organist in Weimar from 1708 to 1717, and was jailed for a month when he tried to leave. Liszt led the court music from 1848.
